synthesizedFacts.fact: Rosacea is a chronic skin condition characterized by persistent facial redness, visible blood vessels, and acne-like bumps.
There is no permanent cure for rosacea, but it can be effectively managed with professional care, lifestyle changes, and appropriate skincare.
Rosacea symptoms can go through periods of remission and flare-ups, often triggered by factors such as sun exposure, stress, heat, spicy foods, or skincare products.
Common treatments for rosacea include prescription topical medications, oral antibiotics, laser and light therapy, and medical-grade skincare.
